# Community conduct

Keep discussion respectful, specific, and focused on the project. Critique code
and ideas without personal attacks. Harassment, threats, discriminatory language,
and sharing another person's private information are not welcome.

Maintainers may edit or remove harmful content and restrict participation when
necessary. For a conduct concern, use GitHub's reporting tools or ask a maintainer
for a private contact channel without posting personal details publicly.

These expectations apply to issues, pull requests, reviews, and other spaces
maintained for this project.
